extracted.name: Cauliflower Cakes
extracted.description: Fried Cauliflower Cakes are a quick, simple, and budget‑friendly snack that turn basic riced cauliflower into something golden, crispy, and satisfying. They’re lightly seasoned, pan‑fried until perfectly browned, and great as a side dish, appetizer, or a healthier alternative to potato cakes. With just a few ingredients and a short cook time, they’re perfect for busy days or last‑minute cravings.
